{{Top|leg}}
The '''Queen's Own Grenadiers''' were a military formation on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that had been settled thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by stranded [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] which had been cut off from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] until it was rediscovered by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
